vggish_mlp.head: 128 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm, and dropout
vggish_mlp.epoch_selection: minimum inner-validation loss, followed by refit on outer train plus validation for that epoch count
vggish_mlp.class_weight: balanced from the current training units only

ast_shared.segment_to_call_pooling: arithmetic mean of AST pooler_output embeddings within each call before the classifier head
ast_shared.head: 768 -> 128 -> 3 with ReLU, BatchNorm, and dropout
ast_shared.epoch_selection: minimum inner-validation loss, followed by refit on outer train plus validation for that epoch count
ast_shared.class_weight: balanced from the current training calls only

ast_probe_guided_adapter.initialization: Xavier down projection and zero-initialized up projection

layer_probe.data_boundary: inner-train cats only for the current repeat and outer fold
layer_probe.features: precomputed call embeddings from each of 12 AST encoder blocks
layer_probe.classifier: StandardScaler plus balanced multinomial logistic regression, C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=2000
layer_probe.selection_rule: top two distinct layers with shallower-layer tie break
layer_probe.seed: the frozen inner_seed for the current repeat and outer fold

analysis.oof_unit: one complete 111-cat prediction set per pipeline, split repeat, and base model seed
analysis.hierarchical_resampling: stratified cats once per replicate, then split repeats and model seeds with replacement; use matched draws for both pipelines

scope_boundary.inner_only: train and validate on the nested inner roles without evaluating or exporting outer-test predictions
scope_boundary.formal: requires a completed execution lock before any outer-test prediction is produced
